acquisition: One scene (hydrosat:scene_id). Its L1B and L2 products count once.
footprint: One footprint per scene, the same at every level.
cloud: For the whole scene, so a cloudy scene can still be clear over a small site.
scope: L1B and L2 by day, and nighttime L1B (thermal only). Night scenes have no cloud cover, so the cloud test does not apply to them. L1A has no cloud cover and is left out: a scene's L1A shares its hydrosat:scene_id, so what is shown here holds for its L1A.
